rapport_notes: Professional and efficient; smooth handling of a partial storage-unit move (only taking half the contents).

evidence_quotes.agenda: do you have any specific questions or concerns that you want answered about this move on this call today?
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer said 'No, no' to concerns -- nothing raised to dig into.

top_strength: Clean explicit close -- directly asked 'do you want me to go ahead and secure that spot?' and got a yes, converting the call to a booking rather than leaving it open.
coaching_note: None of the five Save Your Ass lines were used before the close -- add at least the window-framing and fair-then-silence lines to reinforce the price before asking for the booking.
